isolation: fork_turns none for every original reader dispatch; instruction-based file access restriction, not OS filesystem sandbox isolation
model_effort: All readers explicitly gpt-6-luna/high; all source/coverage/grading reviewers gpt-6.1-sol/high; actual runtime metadata separately retained.

variants.protocol: Guide blind-reader template: only frozen summary/questions; answer all requested parts, abstain unsupported, id/answer/support/evidence; no sources/key/prior outputs/history/web/other knowledge.

variants.addition: Use enough detail to resolve every requested part; section citations do not substitute for answering.
Enumerate compound requested clauses as separate numbered parts; fully describe requested procedures; check every requested part in same answer.
Generic clause completeness and procedural detail self-check.
Explicit complete-input chunking when tool truncates; no telegraphic omissions, no brevity requirement, quantities/destinations/timing/exceptions.
requested_parts array plus numbered complete answer and per-question pre-submit check.

limitations: Prompt self-check emphasis changed, so score differences cannot be attributed solely to summary changes or model performance. Questions/keys were held fixed within each repair series; source/key corrections are versioned.
